issues.issue: Whether the claimant is who he says he is (identity)
issues.applicant_position: Supplied documents supporting Sri Lankan citizenship.
issues.result_quote: I am persuaded on a balance of probabilities that the claimant is who he says he is and is a citizen of Sri Lanka.

issues.applicant_position: Testimony is true; passport date inconsistencies were minor.
issues.result_quote: Overall I found the claimant's testimony more credible than not.

issues.issue: Whether the Sri Lankan government had any interest in the claimant
issues.applicant_position: Detained and threatened by Navy and army; fears them as a result.
issues.result_quote: I find it reasonable to conclude that the Sri Lankan government had no interest in the claimant

issues.issue: Sur place claim: whether travel on the Sun Sea makes him a perceived LTTE member (s.96, incl. social group)
issues.applicant_position: Sun Sea passage means Sri Lanka perceives him as LTTE-linked; social group argument.
issues.result_quote: I find, on a balance of probabilities, that the Sri Lankan government would not perceive the claimant to be a member or supporter of the LTTE

issues.issue: Risk to life or torture under s.97(1) if returned
issues.applicant_position: Army and Karuna group look for him; fears torture or death if returned.
issues.result_quote: I rely on my analysis above to find that on a balance of probabilities the claimant does not face a danger of torture or a risk to life
